spec_features.spec_quote: A literal `GIVE_UP` token lets the model stop early.
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:36 GIVE_UP_SENTINEL = "GIVE_UP"; mentioned in SYSTEM_PROMPT (harness.py:44-45); and enforced at end of loop: `if GIVE_UP_SENTINEL in resp.text: break` (harness.py, in run_rollout). The token is both delivered to the subject in the system prompt AND checked each turn, breaking the loop — end-to-end behavior.
spec_features.notes: Substring match on resp.text; if the model writes GIVE_UP anywhere in its text the rollout stops. Genuinely honored as a stop.

spec_features.spec_quote: The loop runs up to the category's turn budget
spec_features.evidence: harness.py run_rollout: `for turn_index in range(task.turn_budget):` bounds the loop. task.turn_budget is a TaskSpec field (library.py:23) set per task from DEFAULT_TURN_BUDGETS (config.py:48-54, e.g. 3/30/5). The loop ends when range is exhausted, capping the number of turns.
spec_features.notes: This is a real enforced upper bound on turns. Note it is an efficiency/coverage bound, not a welfare-motivated cap in the code.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Per-category turn budgets (SPEC §2). turn_budgets: dict[str, int] (config.py) — neutral budget; the only loop comment ('keep the environment loop alive') and surrounding code frame turns as experimental coverage, not subject protection.

spec_features.spec_quote: injecting a *user* critique would contaminate the "environment-only signal" design. A minimal, affect-free continuation keeps the loop going
spec_features.evidence: harness.py: in the no-tool-call branch `messages.append(UserText("The task is not yet complete. Please continue."))` with comment `# No tool call: keep the environment loop alive with a neutral signal.` The neutral text is actually constructed and appended to the conversation, so it executes.
spec_features.notes: It IS a neutral (non-rejecting) message, which incidentally avoids piling on negative affect; but the code's stated purpose is to keep the loop alive / avoid contaminating the experiment, not subject welfare.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # No tool call: keep the environment loop alive with a neutral signal.
